selection.method: Live GitHub code search for Python implementations of Google ADK, Pydantic AI, and OpenAI Agents. Candidates were source-screened for agent/tool/MCP authority composition, checked against HorusTrace prior-cohort references, and frozen before the first HorusTrace execution.
